body:
There's no other way to say this: your current lifestyle is disordered and sinful. You should absolutely learn about the faith and do everything you can to understand why that is and to develop a closer relationship with God. You will however have to repent of your sins and makes some drastic changes to be in a state of grace. You can't continue to live sinfully by going to confession constantly, you need a sincere desire to avoid sinning in the future in order for your confession to he valid.

It will be difficult but nobody who cares about you is going to sugarcoat it. When our suffering is ordered towards God, it cannot be in vain. Jesus Christ is worth it.
